winecidermead.name: Bochet Reserve
winecidermead.description: A rich bochet mead crafted from caramelized honey, aged on whiskey chips and Madagascar vanilla bean. Tasting notes of whiskey, toasted marshmallow, chocolate, oak warmth, and faint vanilla sweetness!

winecidermead.name: 2025 Pinot Gris
winecidermead.description: Another delicious Pinot Gris from happy vines. So crisp and light that you will immediately reach for it when you are ready to relax on your porch after a busy day. Warm color, nice fruit aromas, and a refreshing dry finish.

winecidermead.name: Black Cherry Wine
winecidermead.description: This sweet ruby red wine presents succulent flavors of fresh ripe black cherries balanced by a subtle touch of tannins!

winecidermead.name: Pineapple Vanilla
winecidermead.description: Our sparkling session mead made with WG Bee Farm's wildflower honey, pineapple puree, and madagascar vanilla bean! It provides tasting notes resembling a tart pineapple cider, with honey, floral, and vanilla undertones!

winecidermead.name: White Zinfandel
winecidermead.description: Light and refreshing with notes of strawberry, watermelon, and a hint of citrus, finishing crisp and smooth.

winecidermead.name: Tempranillo
winecidermead.description: Presents aromas of light cherry and plum accompanied by tasting notes of cherry, plum, tobacco, leather, oak and vanilla, possessing a medium acidity with medium to high tannins!

winecidermead.name: Orange Blossom Mead
winecidermead.description: A mead made from Orange Blossom honey that has tasting notes of sweet honey and citrus upfront with floral undertones and a warming complex alcohol in the finish!

winecidermead.name: Orchard Drive
winecidermead.description: Our Flagship cider made with a blend of Macintosh and Granny Smith Apples. Crisp and refreshing, it highlights both the tartness and the sweetness of the apples.

winecidermead.name: Strawberry Wine
winecidermead.description: This wine is bursting with fresh, juicy berry flavor. Light, refreshing, and slightly tart with a smooth, sweet finish that keeps it easy to sip.

winecidermead.name: Lemon Lavender Mead
winecidermead.description: Crafted with lemons, lavender, lemon blossom honey, and wildflower honey, this sweet mead offers a bright lemony citrus character balanced by soft floral notes and lavender aromatics!

winecidermead.name: Green Tea Lemonade Mead
winecidermead.description: A light and refreshing mead blending smooth green tea with bright, tart lemonade and honey sweetness.

winecidermead.name: Grapefruit Mead
winecidermead.description: A semi-sweet Melomel mead with bright grapefruit citrus, balanced honey sweetness, and a light oak finish. Crisp, slightly tart, and refreshing.

winecidermead.name: Apple Wine
winecidermead.description: Crisp and refreshing with bright apple flavor, a touch of sweetness, a hint of tartness, and a smooth, clean finish!

winecidermead.name: Blue Raspberry
winecidermead.description: This Sweet Fruit Wine provides tasting notes reminiscent of your favorite blue raspberry candies!

winecidermead.name: 2024 Bottled Blonde
winecidermead.description: A sweeter white wine made with 1000% Vidal. Soft but crisp. Also nice as a dessert wine.

winecidermead.name: 2025 Old Virginia Red
winecidermead.description: Old Virginia Red continues to be a crowd pleaser - smooth, light and great with food. The 2024 vintage features 100% Chambourcin.

winecidermead.name: Strawberry Rhubarb Vanilla Mead
winecidermead.description: A Sweet Melomel Mead that has delicate tasting notes of sweet honey, strawberry, rhubarb, and vanilla!

winecidermead.name: Moscato
winecidermead.description: A nice sweet white presenting tasting notes of white peach, apricot, orange blossom, and honeysuckle!
